audience: pool service companies that plan routes and jobs in Pool Service Software and check their invoices

useCases.title: See which technician services which pool and when
useCases.text: List the service routes to see which technician visits which property, on which weekday and in which stop order. Open one route for the details.

useCases.title: Review open invoices and their balances
useCases.text: Filter the invoices by client, status or issue date. Open one invoice to see its line items, payments and balance.

useCases.title: Check what the team recorded on a service day
useCases.text: List the visits of a day in service-time order. Open one visit to read its pool readings, checklist items and chemical dosages.

useCases.title: Add a new client with a pool property
useCases.text: Create a client with a first name and a client type. Then add a pool or site for that client with its address and start date.

useCases.title: Create a job and put it on a route
useCases.text: Create a job for a client with a subject and a duration type. Then schedule it on a day's route, first, last or optimized.

useCases.title: Update the price list of parts and services
useCases.text: List the catalog items with their rates and stock. Add a new item or change the fields of an existing one.
